body:
## Best gifts for runners at a glance

- **Best overall:** Garmin Forerunner 265, £247 at Amazon (33% off)
- **Best cheap:** Compressport racing socks, £11.19 at SportsShoes, or a TriggerPoint foam roller, £20.72 at Amazon
- **Best for a beginner:** Fitbit Charge 6, £74.99, or Garmin Forerunner 165, £144.99, both at Amazon
- **Best for recovery:** Theragun Mini, £159 at Amazon
- **Best splurge:** Garmin fēnix 8 47mm, £484.99 at Amazon

## How to choose a gift for a runner

**Find out how serious they are.** Someone doing parkrun on Saturdays needs different kit from someone training for a marathon. For a newer runner, the Fitbit Charge 6 or Forerunner 165 covers GPS, pace and heart rate. For someone following a plan, the Forerunner 265 adds training readiness, recovery advice and race predictions. The fēnix 8 is for trail, ultra and outdoor types who want maps and long battery life.

**Check their phone and ecosystem.** An Apple Watch only works with an iPhone. Garmin and Fitbit work with both iPhone and Android. If they already use a Garmin, accessories like the HRM 600 strap are a better gift than a second watch.

**Don't guess shoe sizes.** Running shoes are personal, and the wrong model can cause injury. If you want to buy shoes, a gift card for a running shop is safer. Socks, a foam roller or a massage gun fit everyone.

**Think about safety.** Open-ear headphones like the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 let a runner hear cars and cyclists, which normal earbuds block out. Many running clubs and races prefer them.

## What's a good price this week?

Garmin is the brand to buy this week: the Forerunner 265 at £247 and the Forerunner 70 at £174 are both well below their usual prices. The Forerunner 165 has dipped to about £120 before, so £144.99 is fair rather than a record. The Theragun Mini and foam roller have both been cheaper, so buy them if they're the right gift, not for the discount.

Amazon's Black Friday Week ends on Cyber Monday, 30 November. Some prices need Prime, and a [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) also covers fast delivery before Christmas.

## A gift for long runs

Plenty of runners listen to audiobooks on long, slow runs. An [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) makes a cheap extra present: until 17 December, Audible's Black Friday offer is £0.99 a month for three months. Pair it with open-ear headphones and they're set for winter training.

More ideas: [AirPods Black Friday deals](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [treadmill and rowing machine deals](/guides/treadmill-deals-uk/) and all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

## FAQs

### What is the best running watch to give as a gift?

The Garmin Forerunner 265 at £247 is the best all-rounder this week: bright screen, accurate GPS and training tools that suit beginners and marathon runners alike. For a smaller budget, the Forerunner 165 at £144.99 covers the essentials.

### What can I buy a runner for under £25?

Compressport racing socks (£11.19) or a TriggerPoint foam roller (£20.72). Both get used every week.

### Is a massage gun a good gift for a runner?

Yes, if they get sore legs after long runs. The Theragun Mini is small enough for a kit bag and at £159 is £40 under most other shops.

### Are open-ear headphones good for running?

They're the safer choice for road running, because you can still hear traffic. Sound quality and bass are weaker than normal earbuds, so they suit podcasts and audiobooks as well as music.

### Should I buy running shoes as a gift?

Only if you know the exact model and size they already run in. Otherwise a running shop gift card is the better choice.
